dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave (falcate) curvature along the trailing edge spline from ridge to apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-degree backward slope of the convex anterior margin relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.25:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Low-radius convexity defining a smooth melon arc on the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with high thickness relative to its length extending from the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the transition coordinate between the melon and rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A linear dark mark or scar is visible on the upper lateral-dorsal flank, posterior to the eye region.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive dark dorsal cape and saddle pigmentation pattern.
